fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (NTM EPS at Sep-2027 ~$4.70 x 18.5x = $87), FCF yield (~$4.26/share FY28 FCF at 4.75% = $90) and EV/EBITDA (~$3.25B NTM EBITDA x 15x less ~$3.8B Sep-2027 net debt over 575M diluted shares = $78); weights 0.5/0.25/0.25 give ~$85.5, rounded to $86 (plus ~2.3% dividend yield, not included).

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: Bottom-up FY28 (Mar-2028): revenue ~$7.4-7.6B (consensus $7.43B), non-GAAP GM 65.5-66%, opex ~26% of sales -> op margin ~39.5-40.5% (Q2 FY27 guide 38.5-39.5%), interest ~$170M (falling with debt), non-GAAP tax ~8% (Q1 FY27 actual 7.5%; Q2 guide $42-44M), 575M non-GAAP diluted shares -> FY28 EPS ~$4.42-4.55 vs consensus $4.58. NTM EPS as of Sep-2027 (Q3 FY28-Q2 FY29) unhaircut ~$4.85; I apply an explicit ~3% cycle haircut to $4.70 and a mid-cycle multiple of 18.5x (down from 19x because the market at the horizon will be pricing a maturing ~8-quarter upcycle; peers NXPI ~15x, ON ~24x, TXN/ADI ~28-32x) = $87.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: FY28 FCF ~$2.45B: EBITDA ~$3.12B less capex ~$120M (Q1 FY27 $13.9M/qtr, guided higher), cash tax ~$230M, interest ~$175M, working-capital build ~$150M; cross-check: Q1 FY27 FCF $497.6M on $1.485B sales (33.5%) scales to ~$2.4-2.5B at ~$1.85-1.9B/qtr. / 575M shares (includes 23.8M mandatory-convertible shares; FCF is before preferred dividend) = ~$4.26/share, capitalized at 4.75% (raised from 4.5% given 10-yr yields >5%; ON ~4.9%, NXPI ~4.7%) = ~$90.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: NTM EBITDA at Sep-2027 ~$3.25B (non-GAAP op income ~$3.05B + ~$0.2B depreciation; round-1 $3.4B was too high) x 15x = $48.75B EV, less ~$3.8B net debt at Sep-2027 ($5.09B at Jun-2026, paydown ~$250-300M/qtr after ~$275M/qtr common+preferred dividends), = ~$44.9B / 575M shares = ~$78.

bear.story: Upcycle matures by mid-2027: supply-constraint-driven ordering unwinds, book-to-bill falls below 1 in H1 CY2027, distributor inventory rebuilds from 25 days, GM guided back toward 61-62% as price increases fade and underutilization returns; NTM EPS ~$3.60 at ~14.5x amid a semi derating and high yields. Below ~$62.5 the mandatory convertible delivers more shares, a small extra drag.

base.story: Revenue climbs to ~$1.85-1.95B/qtr by mid-2027 on industrial, A&D, auto and data center (~$500M standard products, PCIe Gen6 ramps in 2027); GM holds ~66% (price increase offsets one-time Q2 items), op margin ~40%; non-GAAP tax ~8%; net debt ~$3.8B and under ~1.3x EBITDA; NTM EPS ~$4.70 at ~18.5-19x.

bull.story: Supply constraints ease and backlog ships; revenue approaches the FY23 peak run-rate (~$8B+), op margin 42-44%, NTM EPS ~$5.50; deleveraging reopens buybacks/dividend growth and the market pays ~22x, as at the May-2026 peak ($105.91 on far lower earnings).

thesis_break_reason: $55 is ~12x FY28 consensus EPS ($4.58) and ~11.7x my $4.70 NTM base, ~30% below spot and near the 2025 trough ($48.52). A close there would most likely mean the recovery has reversed (book-to-bill below 1, a guide cut with GM back toward 60-62%, distributor inventory rebuilding from 25 days), not ordinary 50%-vol sector noise. Below ~$62.5 the Series A mandatory convertible also converts into more shares (up to ~29M), adding dilution to a falling price.

Gross margin durability at 66-67% once the price-increase effect is fully in the base and utilization normalizes (long-term model 65%)

Pace of deleveraging (~$250-300M/qtr) and when buybacks/dividend growth resume
reasoning: Round 2 revision. The supervisor's fact checks, which I verified against the Q1 FY27 8-K (non-GAAP tax $35.6M, rate 7.5%; Q2 tax guide $42.2-44.3M; 574.3M non-GAAP diluted shares; long-term debt $5,361M; ~$170M net-debt reduction; FCF $497.6M) and the Citi TMT summary (GM 66-67% through FY27 and flat into December, distributor inventory 25 days, no significant restocking, dividend flat and no buybacks until the balance sheet improves, data center ~$500M in standard products), led to these changes: (1) My round-1 13% tax understated EPS ~6%. Re-deriving with ~8% tax gives FY28 ~$4.42-4.55 and NTM-at-horizon ~$4.85 unhaircut; rather than letting the tax error act as a hidden haircut, I apply an explicit ~3% cycle haircut ($4.70) and trim the multiple to 18.5x because by Sep-2027 the market will price a mature upcycle. P/E leg is essentially unchanged at $87. (2) My deleveraging pace was overstated ($350-400M/qtr vs ~$250-300M after dividends), but the ~$3.8B endpoint stands. (3) On recheck my EBITDA ($3.4B) was high; ~$3.25B lowers the EV/EBITDA leg to $78. (4) FCF yield raised to 4.75% for high yields; leg $90. Blend ~$86 (from $87). (5) I agree the near-term channel risk is lower than a 25% bear weight implies, so bear weight goes to 20% (price $52) and base to 55%; scenario mean ~$89 before dividends. I keep a fattened left tail because the mid-2027 peak risk, 50% realized vol and September sector weakness (memory softness) are real. Ladder: an 87/13 lognormal mixture (median $87.5, sigma 0.40; bear component median $68, sigma 0.50), giving an overall median ~$85 and P(>= spot $79) ~0.57, a small upward shift from round 1 (0.56). Analyst mean PT ~$108 (range $80-135) remains optimistic evidence only. No option data or priors consulted; round 2 used ~4 searches/fetches.
